messages:
jamie.ops: quick ask — for INC-2026-21 we need a narrow forensic path: extend retention for quarantine prefix to 90d and allow a 48h staged export to an encrypted ephemeral bucket. raw kept but access gated. cc @alex.sec @sarah-sre :rotating_light:

alex.sec: need exact guardrails before touching KMS. requirements: (1) who can trigger (2) enforced request tags (evidence_ticket) (3) approval gates (SIRT + CISO + Legal) and (4) audit events emitted on key unwraps. no permanent auditor-grants.

sarah-sre: operational notes: use envelope encryption (DEK per export) wrapped by CMK `cmk_incident_evidence`. scrub pass by default (emails/phones/ssn). raw unmask only after 2 approvers in ticket. create `incident-analyst` role with time-limited binding and logged sessions.

morgan.plat: perf/cost: cap initial export to 150GB, service-level enforcement and `export.size_exceeded` alert. surface an override flow if needed.

david-plat: will implement fail-fast quota and a dry-run endpoint returning `estimated_size_bytes` and `estimated_cost_cents` so analysts can plan.

alex.sec: KMS policy checklist (high level): deny Decrypt unless `aws:RequestTag/evidence_ticket` present and principal in `sec-team`; log `kms:Decrypt` with ticket metadata; block key rotation while ticket open unless emergency breakglass recorded. infra PR must include unit/integration tests for tag enforcement and audit emission.

jamie.ops: I'll file INC-2026-21 with queries and approver list. won't run exports until approvals are recorded. thanks — will ping when ticket is up. :white_check_mark:

audit-bot: [audit] export.requested by=jamie.ops tenant=tenant-21 ticket=INC-2026-21 scope=quarantine retention=90d
